releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Private Locker writing-only, encrypted search/editing, four-digit Diary-style PIN, Pattern, Favourite Name recovery and separate Android Keystore fingerprint. Diary Lock remains unchanged.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 295: Private Locker Lock On button moved out of the writing and search area into a separate Locker Security section above it. It appears only while Lock is OFF and reuses the existing Lock On confirmation flow. Saved encrypted writing, PIN/recovery data, Diary Lock and Note Lock are unchanged.
